name: example-skill-mengto-landing
title: High-Conversion Landing Page
description: Conversion-structured landing page: above-the-fold headline (outcome + audience) with subheadline, one primary CTA and a proof signal, then problem-to-solution, outcome-driven benefits, a 3-step how-it-works, testimonial proof, objection-handling FAQ, risk reversal, and a final CTA mirroring the first. Use when the brief mentions "landing page", "conversion", "high-converting", "single offer", "waitlist page", "trial signup", "sales page". Based on MengTo's landing-page skill.

query.en: Create a high-converting landing page for a reporting automation SaaS: one offer, one CTA, proof, FAQ, risk reversal.
